purpose: Independent human review before TwinLiteNet+ versus YOLOP evaluation

eligible_for_builder_only_when: lane count and boundaries are visually defensible
annotation_contract.hard_cases: Use uncertain=true when markings are not defensible; do not guess.
annotation_contract.boundary_semantics: Mark left and right ego-lane boundaries only; use ordered [x,y] points.
annotation_contract.drivable_area: Not annotated by this queue; no drivable-area metric may be claimed.
annotation_contract.double_review: A second human must independently review the pilot subset before promotion.
